inventory.text: Northwind Outfitters is committed to providing high-quality outdoor and adventure gear.
This handbook sets out the terms, conditions, timeframes and procedures for returns, refunds, store credit and order cancellations.
These policies apply to all purchases made online, in-store, or via authorized telephone orders, within the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and participating international destinations.
Return: Physical return of an item to Northwind.
Refund: Return of payment funds via the original payment method.
Store Credit: Credit issued to customer account, non-expiring.
RMA: Return Merchandise Authorization number.

Most items purchased from Northwind Outfitters may be returned within thirty (30) days of delivery (for online orders) or date of purchase (for in-store purchases) for a full refund to the original payment method.
Items must be in original, unused condition, with all tags attached and in original packaging.
Purchases made between November 1 and December 24 of each calendar year qualify for an extended holiday return window through January 31 of the following year.
Returns without proof of purchase are accepted in-store only, for store credit at the lowest price the item was sold in the last 90 days. A valid government photo ID is required.
Items returned 31-60 days after purchase/delivery may be accepted at our discretion for store credit only, subject to a 15% restocking fee.
Items returned more than 60 days after delivery will not be accepted and will be returned to the sender at the customer's expense.
Unused and unwashed: Gear must not have been used in outdoor conditions.
Original packaging: Boxes, cases, tags, and protective covers must be intact.
All parts included: All components, accessories, manuals, and free gifts with purchase must be returned.
If an item is returned showing signs of wear or missing accessories, Northwind may at its discretion issue a partial refund of 50% to 80% of the purchase price or reject the return.
The following items cannot be returned or refunded, except where the item is defective or we sent the wrong item:
Items marked Final Sale or Clearance at the time of purchase.
Gift cards and electronic gift certificates (cannot be redeemed for cash except where required by law).
Downloadable digital goods, trail guides (PDF), and GPS coordinates.
Personalised, engraved, or custom-configured gear.
Perishable items, including dehydrated meals and energy bars, past 14 days from delivery.
Items returned more than 90 days after delivery under any circumstance.
Visit returns.northwind-demo.example to generate a pre-paid return shipping label and RMA.
Call 1-800-555-0142 (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT, Sat 9am-5pm PT) or use live chat.

Customers who choose store credit instead of a refund to their card receive a 5% bonus on the credit value (up to $25.00 bonus per return).
A flat fee of $5.99 is deducted from the refund for use of our pre-paid return shipping label.
Return shipping is free for exchanges, Gold Club members, or if the return is due to Northwind error.
Return freight for change-of-mind returns is a flat $49.00, deducted from the refund.
Freight pickups must be scheduled with our logistics team at least 3 business days in advance.
Damaged, defective or incorrect items must be reported within 7 days of delivery.
Customer support agents may, at their discretion, allow customers to keep items under $40 rather than returning them. This is limited to two instances per customer per year.
Minor cosmetic flaw | Partial refund (keep item) | 20% refund; item retained
If an item you purchased drops in price within 14 days of your purchase date, you may request a one-time price adjustment for the difference.
Price adjustments are refunded to the original payment method and exclude clearance, flash sales, and Black Friday/Cyber Monday doorbusters.
Subscribers may pause their Trailhead Box subscription for up to 3 months at any time through the customer portal.
Subscription cancellations must be submitted at least 48 hours before the billing date to avoid charges for the upcoming cycle.
